hostHelp: IP address or host name of the broker
askTimeoutHelp: How long the adapter waits for the answer of a dialog on the PC
brokerHintExternal: The adapter connects to an existing MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto or the ioBroker MQTT adapter in server mode). The DesktopControl agents on the Windows PCs connect to the same broker.
brokerHintInternal: The adapter runs its own MQTT broker. In the WinCtl agents on the PCs enter the IP address of the ioBroker server and this port (and the login, if set below).
loginHelp: Built-in broker: optional – if set, the agents have to log in with it
